description: When the person wants the document, downloads the pending original from PNCP now. Free and idempotent. It does not start OCR. Use it when the person opens the document. The body is empty or {} (two bytes at most). A free collector downloads the original at once and the status becomes downloading; without a free collector, the request goes first into the queue.

id.description: Document ID from the procurement record (`get_procurement`).

name: request_original
title: Request the original
